Job Summary

Sysco is the global leader in selling, marketing and distributing food products to restaurants, healthcare and educational facilities, lodging establishments and other customers who prepare meals away from home. Our family of products also includes equipment and supplies for the foodservice and hospitality industries. We operate distribution facilities worldwide serving customers across the U.S., Canada, Europe, the Bahamas and other countries.

Sysco offers a paid 10-week summer internship program in which participants are involved in much more than the day-to-day operations of the company. Interns will be exposed to real projects and challenges in a dynamic company environment designed to give interns real world experiences on what it is like to work at a Fortune 100 company.

Location:

This is a hybrid position located in Houston. Candidates will be local to the Greater Houston area. Relocation is not available.

Duties And Responsibilities



- Works with software development, quality engineering, and documentation teams to design and develop (coding. Programming) features and capabilities
- Documents and tests new software applications
- Participates in design reviews to provide input on functional requirements, product designs, schedules, or potential problems
- Researches, investigates, and fixes a wide range of technical issues
- Ensures quality and performance assurance
- Proactively learns about new technologies

Qualifications

Education



- Students pursuing a Bachelor's degree with concentrations in Computer Science, Information Technology, MIS, or related field
- Strong academic credentials (Minimum GPA of 3.0)

Experience Preferred



- Basic understanding of ASP.net, C#, Python, and SQL.
- Basic knowledge of DevOps, including continuous integration, continuous deployment / delivery, configuration and containerization, infrastructure as a code, and monitoring.

Skills And Abilities



- Familiarity with having an “agile-development” mindset enhanced by a strong customer-focus & results-orientation
- Flexible mindset (not married to a single technology) and demonstrated ability to grow skillset and work across a robust and diverse technology stack
- Willingness and ability to excel in a fast-paced agile environment
- Excellent communication skills required to effectively navigate business stakeholder and technology team relationships
- Leadership and problem-solving skills
- Dynamic learner that isn’t afraid to get their hands dirty
- Exhibit a professional, business-like demeanor
- Ability to manage competing priorities, handle multiple assignments and manage ambiguity in a matrix organization
- Ability to analyze complex issues, reason, think critically and synthesize information

Physical Demands

Reasonable accommodations will be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this job.
fit_why: Generic SWE intern; Python/SQL match, C#/ASP.NET gap, Houston hybrid ignored

We are seeking a curious, motivated, and innovative AI Agent Developer Intern who is eager to build intelligent solutions in a fast-paced, collaborative team environment. Our team values learning, support, and innovation, creating a culture where developers can grow, contribute, and have fun doing great work.  
 What We're Looking For:  
 The ideal candidate is passionate about artificial intelligence, automation, and emerging technologies. They enjoy solving complex problems, experimenting with new tools, and collaborating with others to bring ideas to life. As an AI Agent Developer Intern, you will help design, build, test, and optimize AI-powered agents, copilots, and workflow automations. You'll gain hands-on experience working with modern AI platforms, large language models (LLMs), APIs, and low-code/no-code tools while partnering with experienced front-end and back-end developers, data analysts, strategists, and business stakeholders. 
 Required Skills & Experience:  
 
• Basic programming experience in JavaScript and/or Python  
• Basic understanding of MCP and A2A protocols for AI agents  
• Familiarity with APIs, data structures, and web technologies  
• Proficiency with Git, npm and modern development workflows  
• Strong problem-solving, troubleshooting, and analytical thinking skills  
• Familiarity with prompt engineering and AI-assisted development tools  
• Self-motivated with a passion for learning emerging technologies and growing in a collaborative, team-oriented environment  
• Strong communication skills with the ability to identify workflow challenges, pain points, and automation opportunities through stakeholder discussions  Preferred Skills:  
 
• Working knowledge of Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Platform, Power Automate, Azure Functions, or similar workflow tools  
• Demonstrated ability to build AI projects, chatbots, assistants, and workflow automations  
• Experience designing AI agent personas, roles, knowledge domains, and guardrails  
• Expertise in matching AI models to specific tasks, workflows, and business objectives  
• Hands-on experience with Next.js, React, Vercel Chat SDK and AI Gateway  
• Proficiency with modern AI-assisted development tools and environments  
• Familiarity with agent orchestration and iterative workflow frameworks, such as LangChain  The Details:  
 
• Location: Madison, WI (Candidates must be located in Wisconsin)  
• Start Date: August 2026  
• End Date: December 2026  
• Pay: $15/hour  
• Work environment: Hybrid, open-office setting  
• Hours: We'd love for you to work 40 hours/week, but we're flexible if you need part-time  This is an excellent opportunity to sharpen your development skills while working on real-world projects in a supportive and innovative environment. 
 Ready to grow your development career? Let’s make it happen!
fit_why: Strong AI/LLM, RAG, JS/Python, Git overlap; agent-framework gaps

Valeo is a tech global company, designing breakthrough solutions to reinvent the mobility. We are an automotive supplier partner to automakers and new mobility actors worldwide. Our vision? Invent a greener and more secured mobility, thanks to solutions focusing on intuitive driving and reducing CO2 emissions. We are leader on our businesses, and recognized as one of the largest global innovative companies. 
 
 Ready to tackle the challenges of the vehicle of the future? Join Valeo and revolutionize the comfort and well-being of all passengers! 

 What you will win: 
 As part of a global community of talented people, you will grow and thrive working on advanced technologies for greener, safer and smarter mobility. Our company culture gives all our employees the opportunity every day to #Dare.Care.Share. You will receive a best in class, total compensation package that provides a comprehensive benefits program with real financial value. 

 About Valeo: 
Valeo is a tech global company, designing breakthrough solutions to reinvent mobility. We are an automotive supplier partner to automakers and new mobility actors worldwide. Our vision? Invent a greener and more secured mobility, thanks to solutions focusing on intuitive driving and reducing CO2 emissions. We are leader on our businesses, and recognized as one of the largest global innovative companies. 

 About the Role: 
 As a Software Engineer Intern, you will help shape the future of Software-Defined Vehicles (SDV). In this internship, you will gain hands-on experience by contributing to the design of advanced architectures, the development of intelligent, AI-enhanced in-cabin user experiences, and bridging the gap between cutting-edge software and automotive hardware within a modern Agile environment. 

 We are seeking an intern who can start as soon as possible and work on a year-round basis . 

 Responsibilities Also Include: 
 
• Under the guidance of experienced mentors and as a valued member of our engineering team, you will participate in the following missions: 
• Next-Gen SDV Architecture: Assist in the design and development of robust C++ middleware, APIs, and OS components for future Software-Defined Vehicles. 
• Help implement, test, and debug software using C/C++ and Python across embedded and Linux-based platforms. 
• Contribute to building the backend services and programmable interfaces required to power personalized, AI-enhanced user experiences. 
• Support the team in analyzing system logs, reproducing technical issues, and troubleshooting connectivity and performance problems. 
• Hardware-Software Interface: Help integrate smart algorithms with physical automotive hardware. 
• Learn and apply critical automotive safety standards (such as ISO 26262) in real-world development. 
• AI-Driven Automation: Explore and leverage modern artificial intelligence tools to help optimize CI/CD workflows and improve automated testing procedures. 
• Agile Collaboration: Work closely alongside senior developers in a fast-paced Agile environment, utilizing modern Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) tools and best practices. 

 What You Should Have: 
 
• Currently pursuing a Bachelor's Degree in Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or related field. 
 Join us! 
 Thanks to its strategy focused on innovation, Valeo aims at reducing CO² emissions and developing intuitive driving to propose greener, safer, and smarter mobility. The fantastic (r)evolution towards the vehicule of the future provides amazing career opportunities and challenging jobs! 

 Diversity by nature 
 At Valeo, innovation is driven by the diversity, authenticity and energy of its talents. You are looking for new technological and human adventures? Join Valeo and its more than 100.000 employees across the globe! 

 More information about valeo : https://www.valeo.com
